translations.name: Ida Kushner Central Jersey Diaper Program
translations.description: The Ida Kushner Central Jersey Diaper Program gives diapers to Middlesex County families with a child in diapers. They will not ask for a license, SSN, green card, immigration status or income proof. Register online once (about 2 days), then book an appointment. You can get diapers every other month. Call 732-296-9922.
translations.website_description: Learn how to get diapers and baby supplies.
